# SuitePacific

> Boutique NetSuite post-go-live support and consulting. SuiteScript development, workflow automation, integration maintenance, advanced PDF templates, saved searches and dashboards, and ongoing account management for companies already live on NetSuite.

## Services

- [NetSuite Post-Go-Live Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-post-go-live-support): What ongoing support covers after the implementation ends
- [NetSuite Managed Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-managed-support): Fixed monthly retainer covering development, administration, break-fix, and upgrade preparation
- [NetSuite Care Plans](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-care): Monthly retainer plans from $799 to $2,499/month for ongoing SuiteScript, workflow, reporting, and troubleshooting support; 3-month minimum then month-to-month
- [Hire a NetSuite Developer](https://suitepacific.com/hire-netsuite-developer): Dedicated SuiteScript developer for custom scripts, integrations, and automation; no long-term lock-in
- [NetSuite SuiteScript Development](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-suitescript-development): Custom SuiteScript 2.1 user event, scheduled, map/reduce, client, and RESTlet scripts
- [NetSuite Workflow Automation](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-workflow-automation): Multi-step approval routing, notification automation, and SuiteFlow process management
- [NetSuite Advanced PDF Templates](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-advanced-pdf-templates): FreeMarker-based invoice, purchase order, statement, and custom document templates
- [NetSuite Saved Searches and Dashboards](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-saved-searches-dashboards): Real-time operational visibility through saved searches, KPI tiles, and dashboards
- [NetSuite Health Check](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-health-check): Structured account review to identify performance, customization, and integration issues
- [NetSuite Account Optimization](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-account-optimization): Systematic improvement of an existing NetSuite account: scripts, workflows, integrations, and configuration
- [NetSuite Technical Debt](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-technical-debt): Assessment and remediation of accumulated technical debt from rapid implementation or staff turnover
- [NetSuite Partner Replacement](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-partner-replacement): Transition from an implementation partner to a retained specialist
- [NetSuite Emergency Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-emergency-support): Urgent break-fix for scripts, workflows, and integrations failing in production
- [NetSuite Administrator Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-administrator-support): Fractional NetSuite administrator support for post-go-live accounts: user management, roles, custom fields, saved searches, period management, upgrade prep; plans from $799/month, month-to-month, Oracle Administrator Professional certified
- [Fractional NetSuite Administrator for Small Business](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-admin-support-small-business): Fractional NetSuite admin for small businesses; lighter-touch model covering user management, roles, saved searches, and configuration on a monthly retainer without a full-time hire
- [NetSuite Consulting Services](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-consulting-services): Scoped consulting engagements for specific NetSuite challenges after go-live
- [NetSuite Implementation Rescue](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-implementation-rescue): Stabilizing a NetSuite account after a failed or incomplete implementation
- [NetSuite Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-support): Hub page covering all post-go-live support services: managed retainers, SuiteScript development, workflow automation, integrations, health checks, and emergency break-fix; plans from $799/month
- [NetSuite Integrations](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-integrations): Shopify, Salesforce, Celigo, Boomi, and custom middleware integration maintenance
- [NetSuite Celigo Integration Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-integrations/celigo): Celigo Mastery Level 4 certified; builds, repairs, monitors, and optimizes Celigo integrations between NetSuite and Shopify, Salesforce, HubSpot, Amazon, and custom systems
- [NetSuite SuiteBilling Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-suitebilling-support): Ongoing SuiteBilling configuration, charge generation, ARM, and billing automation support
- [NetSuite FSM Support](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-fsm-support): NetSuite Field Service Management configuration, customization, and upgrade support
- [NetSuite Support UK](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-support-uk): Post-go-live NetSuite support for UK-based businesses
- [NetSuite ACS Alternative](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-acs-alternative): Third-party support that covers customizations and integrations excluded by ACS
- [NetSuite ACS Alternatives Comparison](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-acs-alternatives-comparison): Objective comparison table of Oracle ACS against boutique managed support, Solution Providers, enterprise SIs, and independent consultants; covers pricing model, SuiteScript coverage, integration support, and SMB suitability
- [NetSuite ACS Pricing](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-acs-pricing): How Oracle prices ACS across four tiers (Advise, Monitor, Optimize, Architect), cost estimates at different license values, and comparison to managed support alternatives
- [Do I Need NetSuite ACS?](https://suitepacific.com/do-i-need-netsuite-acs): Decision guide covering when ACS adds value, when it does not, five account scenarios, and what to consider before purchasing or canceling ACS
- [NetSuite Support Alternative](https://suitepacific.com/netsuite-support-alternative): What a third-party consulting firm covers that Oracle support does not

- [SuiteCompare](https://suitepacific.com/suitecompare): Side-by-side comparison of NetSuite record versions and release changes; diff any two records visually

## Resources: SuiteScript

- [NetSuite beforeSubmit vs afterSubmit](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-beforesubmit-vs-aftersubmit): When each User Event trigger fires, why using the wrong one causes silent failures, and how to choose correctly
- [NetSuite User Event Script vs Client Script](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-user-event-vs-client-script): User Event runs server-side; Client Script runs in the browser; choosing the wrong one means business logic silently fails on API saves, CSV imports, and workflow saves
- [record.load() vs search.lookupFields() in SuiteScript](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-record-load-vs-lookupfields): When to use each; lookupFields() is significantly faster for reading a few fields from a known record
- [record.submitFields() vs record.load() in SuiteScript](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-submit-fields-vs-record-load): When to use each update method and the critical User Event caveat before switching
- [Why You Should Never record.load() Inside a Loop](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-avoid-record-load-in-loops): Most common SuiteScript performance mistake; how to batch fetch with saved search columns instead
- [NetSuite Scheduled Script vs Map/Reduce Script](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-scheduled-script-vs-map-reduce): When to use each; using Scheduled Script for Map/Reduce work is the most common cause of governance limit errors in batch processing
- [NetSuite Map/Reduce: Why getInputData() Should Do Almost Nothing](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-map-reduce-getinputdata): getInputData() defines the workload, it does not execute it; loading records inside getInputData() defeats the Map/Reduce framework
- [NetSuite Map/Reduce: Why Each map() Execution Must Be Independent](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-map-reduce-map-independence): Parallel execution breaks silently when map() shares state through global variables or order assumptions
- [Why search.runPaged() Should Replace search.run() for Large Datasets](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-search-runpaged): search.run().getRange() has a 4,000-record ceiling; runPaged() avoids silently missing records
- [NetSuite Script Audit Guide](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-script-audit-guide): How to audit SuiteScript deployments: what to examine, how to read execution logs, how to identify governance problems, and how to find overlap between scripts

## Resources: Workflow

- [Why Your NetSuite Workflow Is Firing Twice](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-workflow-firing-twice): Two most common trigger configuration causes of duplicate workflow execution and how to fix them
- [NetSuite Workflow Entry Conditions](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-workflow-entry-conditions): A workflow without an Entry Condition evaluates on every record save; how Entry Conditions reduce unnecessary evaluations and improve performance on high-volume accounts
- [NetSuite Workflow Audit Guide](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-workflow-audit-guide): How to audit SuiteFlow configurations: what to examine in the workflow editor, how to identify over-broad entry conditions, and how to classify findings by severity

## Resources: SuiteQL and reporting

- [NetSuite Saved Search vs SuiteAnalytics Workbook](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-saved-search-vs-suiteanalytics-workbook): Saved Searches and Workbooks serve different purposes; using the wrong one leads to slow reports; learn the distinction and how to choose
- [Why Your NetSuite Saved Search Got Slower Over Time](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-saved-search-performance): Saved searches accumulate formula columns, joined fields, and summary calculations; how to diagnose the cause and when to move to SuiteAnalytics Workbook
- [How to Use Bound Parameters in NetSuite REST SuiteQL](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-suiteql-bound-parameters): Pass dynamic values to SuiteQL queries separately from the query string to prevent injection vulnerabilities
- [How to Fix SuiteQL Queries After the 2026.2 Default Sort Change](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-suiteql-orderby): NetSuite 2026.2 changed default Transaction sort from tranDisplayName to tranDate; how to find and fix affected queries

- [How to Use Payment Runs in NetSuite](https://suitepacific.com/resources/netsuite-payment-runs): Groups vendor bills, credits, journal entries, and expense reports into a single reviewed and approved payment workflow introduced in 2026.2

## About

SuitePacific is a boutique consulting firm focused exclusively on post-go-live NetSuite accounts. Credentials: SuiteCloud Developer II, Administrator Professional. Engagements are month-to-month; no annual lock-in. Direct access to the consultant managing the account on every request. Serving clients in the US, UK, and Australia.
